purpose: Provide one bounded counterexample preventing overbroad preservation claims under projection from the Core Expression into domain-specific completed RTs.

non_claims: Does not deny closure-preserving witnesses exist.

counterexample.blocked_claim: Projection from the Core Expression preserves residue, orientation, state, scale-expression, metric value, and slot role across all domains.
counterexample.result: Overbroad preservation claims fail even when both projections are typed and closed.

supported_reading.statement: This witness limits the preservation claim to closure eligibility, identity continuity, and domain-typed RT completeness after closure verification.

forbidden_inferences: The counterexample does not prove all projections fail.
The counterexample does not prove projection invertibility.
The counterexample does not prove all domains behave the same.
The counterexample does not identify the Core Expression with RT_core.
